temporal_state_chain.observed: Ethan notices Gary working excessively long hours, skipping meals, and sacrificing sleep. He invites Gary to a weekend retreat, but Gary declines because there is too much to do at the hospital.
temporal_state_chain.belief_before: Ethan believed Gary was a dedicated, hardworking friend, but may not have fully recognized how severe or unsustainable Gary's work habits had become.
temporal_state_chain.belief_update: Yes. Gary's visibly unhealthy overwork and his refusal to step away reinforce Ethan's concern and make the problem seem more serious.
temporal_state_chain.belief_after: Gary is seriously overworked and at risk, and his hospital obligations are making it difficult for him to accept help or rest.
temporal_state_chain.intention: To intervene and help Gary reduce stress, possibly by persuading him to rest or finding another way to support him.

temporal_state_chain.observed: During the retreat, Ethan sees Gary acting restless and avoiding discussions about work. When confronted gently, Gary says the situation is complicated and that he did not want to burden Ethan.
temporal_state_chain.belief_before: Ethan believed Gary was primarily overworked by hospital demands and needed rest, though Gary was reluctant to take a break.
temporal_state_chain.belief_update: Yes. Gary's restlessness, avoidance of work talk, and reference to a complicated burden lead Ethan to suspect there is more than ordinary professional overload.
temporal_state_chain.belief_after: Gary is carrying a deeper, complicated problem beyond work obligations, and he may be hiding it to avoid burdening others.
temporal_state_chain.emotion: Concerned, sympathetic, worried, and gently suspicious that something else is wrong
temporal_state_chain.intention: To confront Gary compassionately and encourage him to open up so Ethan can help without judging.

temporal_state_chain.observed: Gary opens up about the pressures of managing a new department and personal challenges he is facing. Gary agrees when Ethan suggests prioritizing tasks and delegating responsibilities.
temporal_state_chain.belief_before: Ethan suspected Gary was dealing with more than ordinary work stress, but he did not yet know the specific pressures or personal challenges.
temporal_state_chain.belief_update: Yes. Gary's disclosure confirms and clarifies the deeper causes of his overwork: managing a new department plus personal challenges, and Gary is willing to accept help.
temporal_state_chain.belief_after: Gary's overwork comes from both new departmental pressures and personal difficulties; with practical support and delegation, he can work toward a healthier balance.
temporal_state_chain.intention: To help Gary prioritize tasks, delegate responsibilities, and organize his schedule so he can make time for himself.

temporal_state_chain.observed: Over the following months, Ethan checks in with Gary about his progress and challenges. Gary reports improvement, feels less overwhelmed, and has even had time for a movie.
temporal_state_chain.belief_before: Ethan believed Gary understood the causes of his imbalance and was trying to improve, but still needed ongoing support and encouragement.
temporal_state_chain.belief_update: Yes, in the sense that it strengthens and confirms Ethan's belief that Gary is actively changing and benefiting from support.
temporal_state_chain.belief_after: Gary is making genuine progress toward a healthier work-life balance, though he still faces challenges and benefits from Ethan's encouragement.
temporal_state_chain.intention: To continue checking in regularly, offering support, and encouraging Gary as he sustains his progress.

temporal_state_chain.observed: After a year, Gary has successfully adjusted to a healthier work-life balance and says he feels more in control. Gary thanks Ethan for his support.
temporal_state_chain.belief_before: Ethan believed Gary had been improving but still benefited from regular check-ins and support.
temporal_state_chain.belief_update: Yes. Seeing Gary manage independently and sustain a healthier balance shows Ethan that Gary no longer needs active intervention.
temporal_state_chain.belief_after: Gary is capable of maintaining a healthier work-life balance on his own, and Ethan can step back while remaining available if needed.
temporal_state_chain.intention: To step back and let Gary manage independently, while letting Gary know he is always available if needed.
